question: Which of the following vitamins helps our body to use calcium for bones and teeth?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Vitamin D helps the human body absorb calcium, one of the main building blocks for strong bones and teeth.
 
• Vitamin D thus helps prevent Osteoporosis, a disease that thins and weakens the bones and makes them brittle and more likely to break.
 
• Source - oily fish, egg yolks, red meat, etc.
